messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear colleagues at Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09). Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.6% (sc:70610@2026Q3).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.49 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.41 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.43 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the updated volume forecast and are agreeable to extending the contract term to 24 months.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. In consideration of this longer commitment and the increased volume, we can revise our offer to EUR 5.51 per unit with 30 days net payment terms, alongside a contract term of 24 months. 

Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, our pricing is based on distributor list prices and volume discount tiers; our colleagues will provide further context. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
